explanation: When the carpet is beaten, it moves but the dust stays at rest by inertia of rest and falls off.

exam: APPSC Technical Assistant (Hydrogeology) in AP Ground Water
q: The generation of electricity by flow of water through dams is an example of which of the following?
explanation: Hydroelectricity converts the potential energy of stored water into kinetic and then electrical energy, an example of conservation of energy.
